summary: 10.0.34.17 Enterprise Release - Full 8-Loader Desktop Import Parity, Robust Upsert & Conflict Handling, Dynamic Logic Screens & Progressive Disclosure, Dynamic Settings Branding, Universal Footer Disappearance, and Mock Data Removal
highlights: 1. Full 8-Loader Desktop Import Parity: Complete alignment against desktop ImportService.java, ImportMergePolicy.java, PurchaseReconImportCoordinator.java, and BankStatementImportCoordinator.java for all 8 loaders (Items, Customers/CRM, Suppliers/HRM, Sales, Purchases, Master Categories & Values, Purchase Recon, and Bank Statement).

2. Customer & Supplier Import Conflict Resolution: Force cache refresh on import start, targeted server existence lookup, safe upsert retaining ID and rowVersion, in-memory cache update preventing intra-sheet collisions, and duplicate key conflict recovery.

3. Three Authentication Screens Logic & UI Desktop Parity: Screen 1 Sign In with dynamic server-owned roles from GET /api/auth/login-roles and morphing button modes; Screen 2 Create New Account with 2-column grid, readonly assigned role from GET /api/auth/registration-roles, sequential Step 1 CAPTCHA, Step 2 Email OTP, Step 3 Authenticator QR modal, and Admin approval submission; Screen 3 Reset Password with progressive disclosure Step 1 OTP request and Step 2 verification/reset.

4. Dynamic Branding & Settings Integration: Created BrandingService singleton dynamically binding company name (Jashvi Engineers), tagline, and quotes from database settings (application_setting table via company.* keys) replacing hardcoded strings.

5. Universal Dynamic Footer Disappearance Rule: SharedApplicationFooter parity ensuring blank phone, email, and website vanish completely (display: none) without mock fallbacks or static pipe delimiters, accompanied by live IST date and time clock.
6. Complete Mock Data Removal: Eradicated hardcoded role options, mock company fallbacks, and hardcoded contact phone/email across auth screens and application footer.
